final_metamodel:
# Define the primary 'Course' class with its direct attributes and references
create class Course
create attribute courseCode in Course type String
create attribute courseTitle in Course type String
create attribute credits in Course type int
create attribute description in Course type String
create attribute startDate in Course type Date
create attribute endDate in Course type Date
create reference instructor in Course type Instructor [1]

# Define the primary Student class with its attributes and references
create class Student
create attribute studentId in Student type String
create attribute firstName in Student type String
create attribute lastName in Student type String
create attribute dateOfBirth in Student type Date
create attribute email in Student type String
create reference enrolledCourses in Student type Course [0..*]
